register.name: SILiAmb
register.notes: SILiAmb platform fetched live 2026-08-16. Per-stream enrolment; registration number issued on certificate; annual declarations (correção for previous year + estimativa for current) due by 31 March. Producers without a Portuguese establishment, distance sellers included, must appoint a Portugal-established representative by written mandate.
